records.jp: 夜にプール……なんだかキラキラして幻想的ね
records.en_original: A night pool... It's quite beautiful, isn't it?
records.en: A night pool... It's quite beautiful, isn't it?

records.jp: お昼に入るのとはまた雰囲気変わるよね！
records.en_original: It feels totally different from swimming in the daytime!
records.en: It feels totally different from swimming in the daytime!

records.jp: ええ。昼のプールより夜の方が好きかも。<CR>静かで、大人で……ロマンチックよね
records.en_original: Yes, I think I may even prefer it at night. It's quieter and more...romantic.
records.en: Yes, I think I may even prefer it at night. It's quieter and more...romantic.

records.jp: 星の光に揺れる水面を眺めながら語らう……。<CR>それだけでも充実した時間を過ごせそうじゃない？
records.en_original: Talking while the starlight reflects off the water... What a great way to spend time, don't you think?
records.en: Talking while the starlight reflects off the water... What a great way to spend time, don't you think?

records.jp: ふふっ、美弦さんらしいや
records.en_original: Hehe, I thought you'd say something like that.
records.en: Hehe, I thought you'd say something like that.

records.jp: 夜は私たちに、普段見えない景色を見せてくれる
records.en_original: There are some things that you can only experience at night.
records.en: There are some things that you can only experience at night.

records.jp: けどそれは、逆に普段見えているものを<CR>隠してしまうということでもあるの
records.en_original: Though at the same time, the night can hide things as well.
records.en: Though at the same time, the night can hide things as well.

records.jp: 足元は暗いし、愛央も気をつけて。<CR>昼間より気温も低いから――
records.en_original: Be sure to watch your step in the dark, Ao. Also, it seems the temperature's dropped since daytime, so—
records.en: Be sure to watch your step in the dark, Ao. Also, it seems the temperature's dropped since daytime, so—

records.jp: 美弦さん。本日は……心配性禁止です！
records.en_original: Mio. No worrying allowed!
records.en: Mio. No worrying allowed!

records.jp: し、心配性禁止……？
records.en_original: N-no worrying...?
records.en: N-no worrying...?

records.jp: そう！　美弦さんっていつも、<CR>私たちのことを暖かく見守ってくれてるけど
records.en_original: Yes! You're always looking out for us in one way or another.
records.en: Yes! You're always looking out for us in one way or another.

records.jp: たまには他の人の心配を忘れて、<CR>ゆったりのんびりすることも大切だと思うわけです
records.en_original: But sometimes it's important to forget about all that stuff and just enjoy yourself!
records.en: But sometimes it's important to forget about all that stuff and just enjoy yourself!

records.jp: というわけで禁止禁止！
records.en_original: So, there will be none of that tonight!
records.en: So, there will be none of that tonight!

records.jp: そんなわざわざ禁止なんてしなくても、<CR>普段からそこまで気を張ってるわけではないわよ？
records.en_original: You don't need to say that, I'm not always that on edge.
records.en: You don't need to say that, I'm not always that on edge.

records.jp: ほほう……では心理テストです
records.en_original: Oh, yeah? All right then, I have a question for you.
records.en: Oh, yeah? All right then, I have a question for you.

records.jp: もし私がプールで泳いでるのを見かけたら、<CR>どうしますか？
records.en_original: Imagine I'm swimming in the pool all by myself, what do you do?
records.en: Imagine I'm swimming in the pool all by myself, what do you do?

records.jp: ええと、タオルと飲み物を準備して、<CR>更衣室に行って脱ぎ散らかしてある服を畳んで……
records.en_original: Let's see... I'd get a towel and a drink for you, then pick up the clothes you'd left in the locker room...
records.en: Let's see... I'd get a towel and a drink for you, then pick up the clothes you'd left in the locker room...

records.jp: それから上がるときに、<CR>すぐ温かいシャワーが出るように調整して
records.en_original: Then I'd make sure the water in the shower was nice and hot for you.
records.en: Then I'd make sure the water in the shower was nice and hot for you.

records.jp: うーん……念のためにタワシと傘とスコップも<CR>用意しておいたほうがいいかしら……
records.en_original: Hm... Maybe it would be best if I got you a brush, umbrella, and sunglasses just in case...
records.en: Hm... Maybe it would be best if I got you a brush, umbrella, and sunglasses just in case...

records.jp: もし私が廊下を歩いてるのを見かけたら、<CR>どうしますか？
records.en_original: What would you do if you saw me walking in the hallway?
records.en: What would you do if you saw me walking in the hallway?

records.jp: 普通に挨拶をするわね
records.en_original: I'd say hello.
records.en: I'd say hello.

records.jp: それで声に元気がなかったりしないか確認して、<CR>次に身だしなみが崩れてないか確認して……
records.en_original: I'd see if you were feeling okay based on the tone of your voice, then make sure you looked okay.
records.en: I'd see if you were feeling okay based on the tone of your voice, then make sure you looked okay.

records.jp: あとは膝の動きと肩の動きと……<CR>そうね、念のため足跡も確認しておきましょう
records.en_original: After that, I'd look at your knees and shoulders... Then I think I'd make sure your gait was okay as well.
records.en: After that, I'd look at your knees and shoulders... Then I think I'd make sure your gait was okay as well.

records.jp: ほら心配性！<CR>思いやりも行き過ぎると意味不明だよ！
records.en_original: See?! You worry way too much! If anything you're TOO thoughtful!
records.en: See?! You worry way too much! If anything you're TOO thoughtful!

records.jp: 心配性……知らなかった……
records.en_original: I see... I had no idea...
records.en: I see... I had no idea...

records.jp: うむ。どうやら自覚できるようになったみたいだね
records.en_original: Yeah. Though I'm glad it seems like you've recognized it now.
records.en: Yeah. Though I'm glad it seems like you've recognized it now.

records.jp: じゃあ次はそれを抑えてみるんだ！！
records.en_original: Now you've gotta try and resist!
records.en: Now you've gotta try and resist!

records.jp: そうだね……まずは分かりやすいところから
records.en_original: Let's see... Let's start with the easy stuff.
records.en: Let's see... Let's start with the easy stuff.

records.jp: 偉そうな態度を取ろう！<CR>足を組んで座ってみるとか
records.en_original: Try acting super aloof! Sit with your legs crossed!
records.en: Try acting super aloof! Sit with your legs crossed!

records.jp: え、ええ……？<CR>こんな感じかしら……？
records.en_original: H-huh...? Like this...?
records.en: H-huh...? Like this...?

records.jp: さらに見下すような目線！
records.en_original: Now make it seem like you really look down on me!
records.en: Now make it seem like you really look down on me!

records.jp: こう……？
records.en_original: Is this right...?
records.en: Is this right...?

records.jp: もっとテキトーな感じが出るように、<CR>喋り方をギャルっぽくしよう
records.en_original: You should talk like a valley girl to make it seem like you don't really care.
records.en: You should talk like a valley girl to make it seem like you don't really care.

records.jp: 私のことも「あおっぴ」って呼んでね！
records.en_original: Say stuff like "totally" or "whatever..."!
records.en: Say stuff like "totally" or "whatever..."!

records.jp: ま、待って愛央！　それでほんとに――
records.en_original: W-wait, Ao. I don't know about—
records.en: W-wait, Ao. I don't know about—

records.jp: 「愛央」じゃなくて「あおっぴ」！
records.en_original: Do it!
records.en: Do it!

records.jp: あ、あおっぴ……
records.en_original: Wh-whatever...
records.en: Wh-whatever...

records.jp: ぐへへ……すっごくいい感じだよ！
records.en_original: Heheh... Perfect.
records.en: Heheh... Perfect.

records.jp: じゃあ次は――
records.en_original: Now...
records.en: Now...

records.jp: 深く考えるのをやめよう
records.en_original: Stop thinking so much.
records.en: Stop thinking so much.

records.jp: とりあえず最強とか最高とかすごいとかやばいとか……
records.en_original: Just empty your mind of all those worries...
records.en: Just empty your mind of all those worries...

records.jp: そういう感覚だけで喋るようにすると心配性が、<CR>ぐっと抑えられるんだ！
records.en_original: If you can simply do that, you won't sound so worried when you talk!
records.en: If you can simply do that, you won't sound so worried when you talk!

records.jp: 最強……最高……
records.en_original: Empty my mind...
records.en: Empty my mind...

records.jp: 一人称が「私」なのも良くないな……変えよう
records.en_original: You should change how you refer to yourself.
records.en: You should change how you refer to yourself.

records.jp: ええっ！？　で、でも愛央もそれは同じじゃない！
records.en_original: What?! I don't know if that's such a good—
records.en: What?! I don't know if that's such a good—

records.jp: まあまあ、それは置いておいて、<CR>新しい一人称は「ミオミオ」だ！
records.en_original: Don't worry so much. You will from now on call yourself Miomio!
records.en: Don't worry so much. You will from now on call yourself Miomio!

records.jp: ミオミオ！？
records.en_original: Miomio?!
records.en: Miomio?!

records.jp: ふぅ、だいぶ良くなってきたね……
records.en_original: Yeah, that's much better...
records.en: Yeah, that's much better...

records.jp: ねえ愛央、これって私で遊んでるわけじゃ――
records.en_original: Ao, are you just messing with—
records.en: Ao, are you just messing with—

records.jp: でもまだまだだよ！！<CR>目指せ！　脱心配性！
records.en_original: I'm not done yet! We can make you even more chill!
records.en: I'm not done yet! We can make you even more chill!

records.jp: み、道は険しいわね……
records.en_original: I-I don't have a good feeling about this...
records.en: I-I don't have a good feeling about this...

records.jp: フラグメント「<CLGR>%s<CLNR>」を<CR>手に入れました
records.en_original: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
records.en: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
